# Editable Info Card

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/editable-info-card`

Real consumers: **4** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The constrained authoring form of InfoCard. It owns its text inputs, editing states, typography, and shell; callers provide controlled strings and lifecycle callbacks.

> **Guidance:** Use only on authoring surfaces because player-facing reveals use InfoCard, and EditableInfoCard accepts no children, render callbacks, className, or style props.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `EditableInfoCardField` | no | — | Optional editable headline. Omit for definition-only cards. |
| `body` | `EditableInfoCardField` | yes | — | Editable definition copy. |
| `bodyFormat` | `"plain" \| "rules"` | yes | — | Semantic renderer used for the definition while it is idle. |
